answer: Put every new identity through a probationary window before it can vote or earn: it posts a registration bond and waits, like a cedar sapling, while anyone may challenge it as a duplicate and claim a bounty from that bond if the proof holds. A single honest newcomer passes quietly, but a Sybil farmer must fund a bond for every fake and watch each one sit exposed, where one echo of copied behaviour triggers a challenge that burns its stake. Willow-flexible appeals protect the innocent, yet mass forgery becomes a lottery the farmer keeps losing.
